#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail
readonly out="$HOME/.cargo-target/mantle-cairn-resume-20261026/nix-orchestrator-repair"
if [[ -e "$out" ]]; then exit 1; fi
mkdir -p "$out"
export TMPDIR=/home/brittonr/.cargo-target/t
export XDG_CACHE_HOME=/home/brittonr/.cargo-target/xdg-cache
export NIX_CONFIG=$'builders =\nbuild-dir = /datapool/mantle-store/nix-build-dir-20261025'
failed=0
check() {
  local label="$1" status
  shift
  printf '%s\n' "$*" > "$out/$label.command"
  "$@" > "$out/$label.stdout.log" 2> "$out/$label.stderr.log"
  status=$?
  printf '%s\n' "$status" > "$out/$label.exit"
  printf '%s exit=%s\n' "$label" "$status"
  if ((status)); then failed=1; fi
}
